applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India ( Small Finance Banks– Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: No action is required as these directions merely permit small finance banks to optionally accept certified documents for Foreign Portfolio Investors.
answer.action_quote: Provided that in case of Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) and Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs), as defined in Foreign Exchange Management (Deposit) Regulations, 2016 {FEMA 5(R)}, and Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs), the bank may alternatively obtain the original certified copy

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into force with immediate effect.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks – Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025
